headline: Weathered Expanse Exchanges Accelerate as Mooring County Battles Persist
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, tactical exchanges have flared anew across the Weathered Expanse, where ten strategic base transitions and over thirteen hundred casualties were logged in the past two hours amid fierce contention over Wightwalk and Frostmarch. In Mooring County, combat remains intense with four additional base shifts and upwards of twenty-five hundred casualties in the same period, bringing the sector to nine Warden holdings, two Colonial positions, and one neutralized outpost. The Stlican Shelf also registered six rapid transfers around Briar and Breaker Town, while Godcrofts marked an isolated transition at Argosa. Conversely, fighting has subsided in Pari Peak following its earlier contest over Little Raakkua. Severe attrition persists without territorial movement across Linn of Mercy, Nevish Line, Stonecradle, and Callahan's Passage, maintaining pressure along the broader front.
